history.name: Indigo
history.task: Check internet connection - something is hanging. Test connectivity to github.com, check DNS, ping some servers, see what's wrong with the network.
history.summary: Network diagnosis complete: Internet is working, but GitHub (github.com/api.github.com) has ~70% packet loss. Other sites work fine (Google, Cloudflare, GitLab, Bitbucket). raw.githubusercontent.com works. ICMP ping to GitHub works 100%, but TCP connections fail intermittently. This suggests either: (1) rate limiting from GitHub/ISP on the 140.82.x.x range, (2) some intermediate router dropping TCP SYN packets, or (3) ISP-level filtering. Not a local network issue.
